alex: hey all, alex here (new hire). hitting failures building runtime from source on WSL2 + RTX 3080. followed devex guide but cmake/make fails with nvcc/include errors. anyone know quick checks? :wave:

marta: welcome! common culprits: missing CUDA toolkit vs only driver installed, wrong CUDA_HOME, or nvcc pointing at distro package. can you paste `nvcc --version` and the top cmake error?

alex: nvcc -> V12.1, driver shows 525.60, main error snippet:

```
/opt/cuda/include/host_config.h:56:10: fatal error: cuda_runtime_api.h: No such file or directory
 #include <cuda_runtime_api.h>
```

marta: that usually means cmake picked up headers in /opt/cuda but toolkit is in /usr/local/cuda-12.1. run `ls -l /usr/local/cuda-12.1/include` and check $CUDA_HOME. Also WSL sometimes exposes libcuda under /usr/lib/wsl which confuses linker.

alex: CUDA_HOME was empty. set `export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.1` and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, re-ran cmake and now linker says `ld: cannot find -lcuda`.

marta: try `ls -l /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so*` and `readlink -f /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so`. If it's a procfs symlink, add `-L/usr/lib/wsl` to link flags or prefer building in a full linux VM/container. Our docs recommend the dev-container for GPU builds on WSL.

infra: if needed I can spin up a gpu-dev VM with matching cuda/gcc. ping infra with "vm-quick" tag and I'll allocate a 48h vm.

alex: i'll try the container first. one last Q: build doc mentions gcc-11; system here is gcc-12. should i switch?
marta: nvcc supports up to gcc-11/12 depending on CUDA version; if you see nvcc errors, install gcc-11 and pass `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-11`. dev-container has the right toolchain.

devex-bot: Note added to onboarding checklist: "WSL caveat: prefer dev-container or VM for GPU builds; verify CUDA_HOME/LD_LIBRARY_PATH"

alex: thanks all, switching to container now. will update if I hit anything else. :+1:
